about_the_game:
Add some undeniable uniqueness to your crew with the Crew Skins Pack! It comes with a rogues' gallery of skins to change your existing crew into all kinds of strange characters. Will adding Arengee Penetrael as your Gunner give you the RNG advantage? It won't, but you can tell yourself that if it makes you feel better, and it looks cool, regardless.
Here's what you get with the Crew Skins Pack:
  • "Hellu Van Oob" crew skin
  • "Toma Teu" crew skin
  • "Uni Corn" crew skin
  • "Arengee Penetrael" crew skin
  • "Kannot Gitgud" crew skin

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
